The 1 kHz noise of 527 nV/√Hz is flicker noise from the small NMOS input pair, so this edit gives the pair much more gate area. A PMOS input pair is not viable: its Vsg of about 1 V plus Vcm 0.9 V exceeds VDD = 1.62 V.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Noise is flicker-dominated from the small NMOS pair. Raise pair W*L about 14x: L1 to 2, gm/Id to 20, tail 25 uA. Separate load L, Cc up for PM, I6 up for p2. Noise model now scales with sqrt(W*L) from the measured 527 nV at the old area."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 15.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> wide, low flicker)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # diff pair L (large area -> low flicker)
    "ktail": (2.5, 1.5, 3.5),        # Itail = ktail * iref
    "I6":    (70e-6, 40e-6, 90e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid6": (10.0, 8.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load + CS stage gm/Id
    "L6":    (1.5, 0.8, 2.0),        # PMOS L (load mirror and M6)
    "gmidT": (14.0, 10.0, 17.0),     # NMOS current sources gm/Id
    "LT":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS current source L
    "Cc":    (5e-12, 3e-12, 8e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),        # Rz scale vs zero-cancelling value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["ktail"] * iref
    i1 = itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], itail, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], i1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] * (Cc + cl) / (m6.gm * Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "xd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x1", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "vout", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "x1", Cc)

    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c2 = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    c1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c2 * Cc + c2 * c1 + Cc * c1))
    # mirror pole
    pm3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd))
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pm3)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * pm3)))
    pm = min(pm, 89.0)
    slew = 0.76 * min(itail / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = 1.98 * (iref + itail + I6)
    cmrr = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / mt.gds)
    psrr = db(A1 * A2) - 6
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.15
    # flicker calibrated to previous sim: 527 nV at gmid 16, L 1, Id 7.2 uA
    ref = lut.size("n", 16.0, 1.0, 7.2e-6, vds=0.6)
    fl = 5.27e-7 * math.sqrt(ref.W * ref.L / (m1.W * m1.L))
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise = math.sqrt(fl ** 2 + th ** 2)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "power": power, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise, "vos": 1e-4}
```
